text:
maria: seeing a sharp p50/p95 jump in eu-north1 starting ~07:41UTC, looks correlated with KV cache autoscaler events :thinking_face:
aj: yep getting alerts, graph shows continuous-batcher latency up and a bunch of eviction spikes
kevin: logs show repeated "kv_prefetch: started" entries then long tails, suspect the autoscaler is over-reshuffling hot keys and creating serialization stalls
jules: can we confirm if this is the new autoscaler rollout from yesterday? rollout id: r2026-04-autoscale-3
maria: correct — autoscaler rolled at 02:13UTC. traffic normal until 07:41. patch id r2026-04-autoscale-3 -> candidate for rollback
sam: traffic shift plan? We should avoid global rollback until we mitigate regional pain
aj: two immediate mitigations: 1) pin eu-north1 to hotpool (reserve capacity) 2) disable kv prefetch on that region to stop background churn
kevin: disabled kv prefetch flag in eu-north1 config: `kv.prefetch.enabled=false` via config service

infra-bot: config apply succeeded for eu-north1 (change-id: cfg-9832)
maria: rolling restart batcher pods in eu-north1 to pick up flag

aj: command used:
```
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deployment/batcher --selector=region=eu-north1
```

kevin: after restart p50 dropped ~60ms within 3 minutes, p95 still elevated. seeing fewer evictions but some backlog in hotpool fill
jules: spinning extra hotpool workers (scale +10) — accepts cost hit to protect SLAs

sre-runbook-bot: runbook step executed: manual-hotpool-scale (operator: jules) :heavy_check_mark:

sam: starting traffic reshuffle: divert 15% eu-north1 -> na1 for lighter latency while stabilization continues
maria: added routing rule to gateway: `route-adjust eu-north1 -> na1 15%` — verification in progress

aj: note — this keeps requests routed to na1 instances which are slightly more expensive due to cross-region egress, flagging finance for expected bump
kevin: also found a tight loop in the batcher that retries prefetch on failures — pushing a small hotfix to short-circuit retries (commit: 5f3a9c)

maria: hotfix deployed to eu-north1 canary, observing logs for reduced retry noise

kevin: canary looks clean, no retry storms, planning to roll to remaining pods in 5m
jules: once roll completes we can start shifting traffic back in 5-10% steps, monitor p95 and error budget

maria: post-mitigation notes: autoscaler team to add a backoff to prefetched key reshuffle and a tighter invariant test for serialization windows
sam: finance: heads up — expected transient +22% GPU-burn cost for this region for the hour due to hotpool spin and cross-region reroute

aj: incident summary for oncall: cause = autoscaler reshuffle + kv-prefetch retry tight loop. mitigations = disable prefetch, restart batchers, hotpool scale, temporary traffic diversion, apply short-circuit hotfix, planned autoscaler rollback if regression recurs. follow-ups: unit/regression tests, throttle/backoff in autoscaler, playbook update
maria: adding notes to incident channel and creating a postmortem stub. thanks all for fast responses :heart:
